<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8"/>
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"/>
<title>Risk Alert Classifier — README</title>
<style>
/* ═══ DESIGN TOKENS ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
:root{
  --bg:#050510;--surface:#0a0a1f;--card:#0f0f2a;--card2:#141430;
  --accent:#7c3aed;--a2:#06b6d4;--a3:#ec4899;--a4:#10b981;--a5:#f59e0b;
  --text:#e2e8f0;--muted:#64748b;--border:rgba(124,58,237,.2);
  --glow:rgba(124,58,237,.4);--glow2:rgba(6,182,212,.3);
  --red:#ef4444;--green:#10b981;--yellow:#f59e0b;--blue:#3b82f6;
}
*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box;}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;}
body{background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);
  font-family:'Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif;overflow-x:hidden;line-height:1.6;}

/* ═══ CANVAS ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
#bg-canvas{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;opacity:.6;}

/* ═══ BACK TO TOP ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
#top{position:absolute;top:0;left:0;}
.btt{
  position:fixed;bottom:30px;right:30px;z-index:9999;
  width:54px;height:54px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid var(--accent);
  background:rgba(124,58,237,.15);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);
  color:#fff;font-size:20px;cursor:pointer;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  box-shadow:0 0 24px var(--glow);transition:all .3s;
}
.btt:hover{background:var(--accent);transform:translateY(-4px) scale(1.1);
  box-shadow:0 0 40px var(--glow);}

/* ═══ HERO BANNER ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero{
  position:relative;z-index:1;min-height:100vh;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  text-align:center;padding:80px 24px 100px;overflow:hidden;
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 60% at 50% -20%,rgba(124,58,237,.18),transparent),
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 0% 100%,rgba(6,182,212,.10),transparent 50%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 100% 0%,rgba(236,72,153,.08),transparent 50%);
}

/* Rotating ring */
.hero-ring{
  position:absolute;width:700px;height:700px;border-radius:50%;
  border:1px solid rgba(124,58,237,.12);
  animation:spinRing 20s linear infinite;
  pointer-events:none;
}
.hero-ring::before{
  content:'';position:absolute;inset:-2px;border-radius:50%;
  border:2px solid transparent;
  border-top-color:var(--accent);border-right-color:var(--a2);
  animation:spinRing 3s linear infinite reverse;
}
@keyframes spinRing{to{transform:rotate(360deg);}}

/* Orbiting dots */
.orbit{position:absolute;width:500px;height:500px;border-radius:50%;pointer-events:none;}
.orbit-dot{
  position:absolute;top:0;left:50%;width:10px;height:10px;
  border-radius:50%;margin-left:-5px;margin-top:-5px;
  box-shadow:0 0 12px currentColor;
}
.od1{color:var(--accent);animation:orbitSpin 6s linear infinite;}
.od2{color:var(--a2);animation:orbitSpin 9s linear infinite reverse;top:auto;bottom:0;}
.od3{color:var(--a3);animation:orbitSpin 12s linear infinite;left:0;top:50%;}
@keyframes orbitSpin{to{transform:rotate(360deg) translateY(-250px);}}

/* Grid lines */
.hero::before{
  content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;
  background-image:
    linear-gradient(rgba(124,58,237,.03) 1px,transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(124,58,237,.03) 1px,transparent 1px);
  background-size:50px 50px;
}

/* Floating scan line */
.scan-line{
  position:absolute;left:0;right:0;height:2px;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(124,58,237,.4),rgba(6,182,212,.4),transparent);
  animation:scanDown 6s ease-in-out infinite;pointer-events:none;
}
@keyframes scanDown{0%{top:-2px;opacity:0;}30%{opacity:1;}70%{opacity:1;}100%{top:100%;opacity:0;}}

/* Hero Text */
.hero-badge{
  display:inline-block;padding:6px 18px;border-radius:30px;
  background:rgba(124,58,237,.15);border:1px solid rgba(124,58,237,.4);
  font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:var(--accent);letter-spacing:2px;
  text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:20px;
  animation:fadeSlideDown .8s ease both;
}
@keyframes fadeSlideDown{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-20px);}to{opacity:1;transform:none;}}

.hero-title{
  font-size:clamp(38px,6vw,80px);font-weight:900;line-height:1.05;
  letter-spacing:-3px;margin-bottom:16px;
  animation:fadeSlideUp .9s ease both .15s;
}
@keyframes fadeSlideUp{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(30px);}to{opacity:1;transform:none;}}

.hero-title .line1{
  display:block;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fff 0%,rgba(255,255,255,.7) 100%);
  -webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;
}
.hero-title .line2{
  display:block;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--accent),var(--a2),var(--a3),var(--a4));
  background-size:300%;
  -webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;
  animation:gradShift 4s linear infinite;
}
@keyframes gradShift{0%{background-position:0%;}100%{background-position:300%;}}

.hero-sub{
  font-size:18px;color:var(--muted);max-width:680px;margin:0 auto 36px;
  animation:fadeSlideUp .9s ease both .3s;
  font-style:italic;line-height:1.7;
}

/* Tech Stack Badges */
.tech-row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:28px;animation:fadeSlideUp .9s ease both .45s;}
.tbadge{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;
  padding:8px 16px;border-radius:30px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;
  letter-spacing:.4px;border:1.5px solid;cursor:default;
  transition:transform .2s,box-shadow .2s;
}
.tbadge:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);}
.tb-py{border-color:#3b82f6;color:#3b82f6;background:rgba(59,130,246,.08);}
.tb-sk{border-color:#10b981;color:#10b981;background:rgba(16,185,129,.08);}
.tb-im{border-color:#f59e0b;color:#f59e0b;background:rgba(245,158,11,.08);}
.tb-pd{border-color:#f97316;color:#f97316;background:rgba(249,115,22,.08);}
.tb-np{border-color:#8b5cf6;color:#8b5cf6;background:rgba(139,92,246,.08);}
.tb-mp{border-color:#ec4899;color:#ec4899;background:rgba(236,72,153,.08);}
.tb-jp{border-color:#fbbf24;color:#fbbf24;background:rgba(251,191,36,.08);}
.tb-sn{border-color:#06b6d4;color:#06b6d4;background:rgba(6,182,212,.08);}

/* Stat Pills */
.stat-row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;justify-content:center;
  margin-bottom:28px;animation:fadeSlideUp .9s ease both .55s;}
.stat-pill{
  padding:10px 22px;border-radius:30px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
  backdrop-filter:blur(8px);font-size:13px;font-weight:500;
  transition:border-color .2s,transform .2s;
}
.stat-pill:hover{border-color:var(--accent);transform:translateY(-2px);}
.stat-pill strong{color:var(--a2);}

/* Social Row */
.social-row{display:flex;gap:12px;justify-content:center;animation:fadeSlideUp .9s ease both .65s;}
.soc{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:10px 20px;
  border-radius:30px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;text-decoration:none;
  transition:transform .25s,box-shadow .25s;
}
.soc:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);}
.soc-gh{background:#24292e;color:#fff;box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.4);}
.soc-li{background:#0077b5;color:#fff;box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(0,119,181,.3);}
.soc-ig{background:linear-gradient(45deg,#f09433,#e6683c,#dc2743,#cc2366,#bc1888);color:#fff;}

.scroll-hint{
  position:absolute;bottom:32px;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;
  animation:bounce 2.5s ease-in-out infinite;letter-spacing:1px;
}
@keyframes bounce{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0);}50%{transform:translateY(8px);}}

/* ═══ LAYOUT ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.container{max-width:1160px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px 100px;position:relative;z-index:1;}
.section{margin-top:80px;}
.sec-eyebrow{
  font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:2.5px;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--accent);margin-bottom:8px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;
}
.sec-eyebrow::before{content:'';display:block;width:24px;height:2px;background:var(--accent);}
.sec-title{
  font-size:clamp(22px,4vw,34px);font-weight:800;color:#fff;
  margin-bottom:24px;line-height:1.2;
}

/* ═══ TOC ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.toc-wrap{
  background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:20px;
  padding:32px 36px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;
}
.toc-wrap::before{
  content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:3px;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--accent),var(--a2),var(--a3));
}
.toc-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:4px 40px;}
.toc-link{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:11px 0;
  text-decoration:none;color:var(--text);font-size:14px;
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.04);
  transition:all .2s;
}
.toc-link:hover{color:var(--accent);padding-left:6px;}
.toc-n{
  width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:8px;flex-shrink:0;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  font-size:11px;font-weight:800;
  background:rgba(124,58,237,.12);color:var(--accent);
  transition:background .2s;
}
.toc-link:hover .toc-n{background:var(--accent);color:#fff;}

/* ═══ CARDS ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.card{
  background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:18px;
  padding:24px;transition:transform .25s,border-color .25s,box-shadow .25s;
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;
}
.card:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);border-color:rgba(124,58,237,.5);
  box-shadow:0 0 40px rgba(124,58,237,.12);}

/* ═══ METRIC GRID ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.metric-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(190px,1fr));gap:16px;}
.metric-card{
  background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:16px;
  padding:24px 20px;text-align:center;
  transition:transform .25s,border-color .25s,box-shadow .25s;overflow:hidden;
  position:relative;
}
.metric-card::after{
  content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;
  background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0%,rgba(124,58,237,.08),transparent 70%);
  opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s;
}
.metric-card:hover{transform:translateY(-6px);border-color:var(--accent);
  box-shadow:0 0 30px rgba(124,58,237,.15);}
.metric-card:hover::after{opacity:1;}
.mc-icon{font-size:38px;margin-bottom:10px;}
.mc-val{font-size:30px;font-weight:800;color:var(--a2);}
.mc-lbl{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:4px;letter-spacing:.3px;}

/* ═══ TABLES ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.table-wrap{overflow-x:auto;border-radius:16px;border:1px solid var(--border);}
table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;background:var(--card);font-size:13.5px;}
thead tr{background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(124,58,237,.2),rgba(6,182,212,.15));}
th{padding:14px 16px;text-align:left;font-weight:700;color:var(--a2);
    white-space:nowrap;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);letter-spacing:.3px;}
td{padding:12px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.03);}
tr:last-child td{border-bottom:none;}
tr:hover td{background:rgba(124,58,237,.05);}
tr.best-row td{background:rgba(16,185,129,.06)!important;}
.tag{display:inline-block;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:10px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;}
.tg{background:rgba(16,185,129,.15);color:#10b981;}
.tr{background:rgba(239,68,68,.15);color:#ef4444;}
.tb{background:rgba(59,130,246,.15);color:#3b82f6;}
.tp{background:rgba(124,58,237,.15);color:#a78bfa;}
.ty{background:rgba(245,158,11,.15);color:#f59e0b;}
.to{background:rgba(249,115,22,.15);color:#fb923c;}

/* ═══ ANIMATED PIPELINE ═══════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.pipeline{display:flex;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:0;margin:24px 0;overflow-x:auto;}
.pipe-step{
  background:var(--card);border:1.5px solid var(--border);border-radius:14px;
  padding:18px 22px;text-align:center;min-width:110px;
  transition:border-color .25s,transform .25s,box-shadow .25s;
  cursor:default;
}
.pipe-step:hover{border-color:var(--accent);transform:translateY(-4px);
  box-shadow:0 0 24px rgba(124,58,237,.2);}
.ps-i{font-size:30px;margin-bottom:6px;}
.ps-p{font-size:9px;color:var(--accent);font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.8px;}
.ps-l{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text);margin-top:4px;}
.pipe-arr{font-size:20px;color:var(--accent);padding:0 6px;opacity:.7;flex-shrink:0;}

/* ═══ ANIMATED EXPLANATION BOXES ═════════════════════════════════════ */
.explain-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px;}
.explain-card{
  background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:16px;
  padding:22px;transition:all .25s;position:relative;overflow:hidden;
}
.explain-card::before{
  content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:2px;
  transition:opacity .25s;
}
.explain-card:hover{border-color:var(--accent);transform:translateY(-4px);
  box-shadow:0 0 30px rgba(124,58,237,.12);}
.explain-card:hover::before{opacity:1;}
.ec-purple::before{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--accent),var(--a2));}
.ec-cyan::before{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--a2),var(--a4));}
.ec-pink::before{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--a3),var(--a5));}
.ec-green::before{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--a4),var(--a2));}
.ec-yellow::before{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--a5),var(--a3));}
.ec-red::before{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--red),var(--a3));}
.ec-h4{font-size:14px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:10px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;}
.ec-p{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.75;}

/* ═══ ANIMATED PERF BARS ════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.perf-section{
  background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:18px;
  padding:32px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;
}
.perf-section::before{
  content:'ML METRICS';position:absolute;top:-10px;right:-10px;
  font-size:120px;font-weight:900;color:rgba(124,58,237,.04);
  pointer-events:none;font-style:italic;
}
.perf-h4{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:var(--a2);
  text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1px;margin-bottom:20px;}
.perf-bars{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;}
.perf-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;}
.perf-lbl{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;min-width:200px;color:var(--text);}
.perf-track{flex:1;background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);border-radius:30px;height:34px;overflow:hidden;}
.perf-fill{
  height:100%;border-radius:30px;display:flex;align-items:center;
  padding-left:14px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:#fff;
  transition:width 1.8s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);position:relative;
  overflow:hidden;
}
.perf-fill::after{
  content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:-100%;width:60%;height:100%;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.25),transparent);
  animation:shimmer 3s ease infinite;
}
@keyframes shimmer{0%{left:-100%;}100%{left:200%;}}
.perf-score{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;min-width:56px;text-align:right;}

/* ═══ ANIMATED CONFUSION MATRIX ════════════════════════════════════ */
.cm-viz{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr 1fr;grid-template-rows:auto 1fr 1fr;
  gap:4px;max-width:420px;
}
.cm-label{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.5px;}
.cm-cell{
  border-radius:12px;padding:22px 16px;text-align:center;
  transition:transform .2s,box-shadow .2s;cursor:default;
}
.cm-cell:hover{transform:scale(1.04);}
.cm-tn{background:rgba(16,185,129,.15);border:1px solid rgba(16,185,129,.3);}
.cm-fp{background:rgba(245,158,11,.1);border:1px solid rgba(245,158,11,.2);}
.cm-fn{background:rgba(239,68,68,.15);border:1px solid rgba(239,68,68,.3);}
.cm-tp{background:rgba(124,58,237,.15);border:1px solid rgba(124,58,237,.3);}
.cm-val{font-size:28px;font-weight:900;margin-bottom:4px;}
.cm-desc{font-size:11px;font-weight:600;}
.cm-sub{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:2px;}

/* ═══ ROC VIZ ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.roc-visual{
  background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:18px;padding:28px;
}
.roc-bars{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;}
.roc-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;}
.roc-lbl{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;min-width:220px;}
.roc-track{flex:1;background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);border-radius:20px;height:28px;overflow:hidden;}
.roc-fill{
  height:100%;border-radius:20px;display:flex;align-items:center;
  padding-left:12px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:#fff;
  transition:width 2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);
}
.roc-val{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;min-width:50px;text-align:right;}

/* ═══ CHARTS ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.charts-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:20px;}
.chart-card{
  background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:18px;
  overflow:hidden;transition:transform .25s,border-color .25s,box-shadow .25s;
}
.chart-card:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);border-color:rgba(124,58,237,.5);
  box-shadow:0 0 40px rgba(124,58,237,.12);}
.chart-card.full{grid-column:1/-1;}
.chart-head{
  padding:14px 20px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(124,58,237,.07),transparent);
}
.ch-num{
  padding:4px 11px;border-radius:8px;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;color:#fff;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--accent),var(--a3));flex-shrink:0;
}
.ch-t{font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:#fff;}
.ch-d{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);margin-left:auto;}
.chart-img{width:100%;display:block;}

/* ═══ FILE TREE ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.file-tree{
  background:rgba(0,0,0,.4);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:14px;
  padding:24px 28px;font-family:'Courier New',monospace;font-size:13px;line-height:2;
}
.ft-dir{color:var(--a2);font-weight:700;}
.ft-best{color:var(--a4);font-weight:600;}
.ft-file{color:var(--text);}
.ft-cmt{color:rgba(100,116,139,.5);font-style:italic;}

/* ═══ AUTHOR ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.author-card{
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--card2),rgba(124,58,237,.08));
  border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:24px;padding:40px;
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:36px;flex-wrap:wrap;
}
.author-avatar{
  width:108px;height:108px;border-radius:50%;flex-shrink:0;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--accent),var(--a3));
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:48px;
  box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(124,58,237,.25),0 0 50px rgba(124,58,237,.2);
  animation:avatarPulse 3s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes avatarPulse{
  0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(124,58,237,.25),0 0 50px rgba(124,58,237,.2);}
  50%{box-shadow:0 0 0 8px rgba(124,58,237,.1),0 0 80px rgba(124,58,237,.3);}
}
.author-info h3{font-size:24px;font-weight:800;color:#fff;margin-bottom:4px;}
.author-info p{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:16px;}
.contact-links{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;}
.cl{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;padding:9px 18px;
  border-radius:24px;text-decoration:none;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;
  transition:transform .2s,opacity .2s;
}
.cl:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);opacity:.9;}
.cl-gh{background:#24292e;color:#fff;}
.cl-li{background:#0077b5;color:#fff;}
.cl-ig{background:linear-gradient(45deg,#f09433,#dc2743,#bc1888);color:#fff;}

/* ═══ SUMMARY BOX ════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.sum-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:18px;}
.sum-card{
  background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:16px;padding:22px;
}
.sum-card h4{font-size:12px;font-weight:800;color:var(--accent);
  text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1px;margin-bottom:12px;
  padding-bottom:8px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06);}
.sum-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;
  padding:7px 0;border-bottom:1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,.04);font-size:13px;}
.sum-val{font-weight:700;color:var(--a2);}

/* ═══ FOOTER ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.footer{
  position:relative;z-index:1;
  background:rgba(0,0,0,.5);border-top:1px solid var(--border);
  text-align:center;padding:40px 24px;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;
}
.footer a{color:var(--accent);text-decoration:none;}
.footer-wave{
  width:100%;height:70px;
  background:var(--card);
  clip-path:ellipse(55% 100% at 50% 0%);
  margin-bottom:24px;
}

/* ═══ SCROLL REVEAL ══════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(36px);transition:opacity .8s ease,transform .8s ease;}
.reveal.visible{opacity:1;transform:none;}

/* ═══ TOOLTIP ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
[data-tip]{position:relative;cursor:help;}
[data-tip]:hover::after{
  content:attr(data-tip);position:absolute;bottom:calc(100% + 8px);left:50%;
  transform:translateX(-50%);background:rgba(10,10,30,.95);color:var(--text);
  font-size:12px;padding:8px 14px;border-radius:10px;white-space:nowrap;
  border:1px solid var(--border);z-index:100;pointer-events:none;
  box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.4);
}

/* ═══ RESPONSIVE ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media(max-width:720px){
  .toc-grid,.explain-grid,.charts-grid,.sum-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
  .author-card{flex-direction:column;}
  .cm-viz{max-width:100%;}
}
</style>

<!-- THEORY -->
<div class="section reveal" id="theory">
  <div class="sec-eyebrow">🧠 Concepts</div>
  <div class="sec-title">Theory & Key Concepts</div>
  <div class="explain-grid">

    <div class="explain-card ec-purple">
      <div class="ec-h4" style="color:var(--accent);">📐 Logistic Regression</div>
      <div class="ec-p">Uses the <strong style="color:#fff;">sigmoid function</strong> σ(z) = 1/(1+e⁻ᶻ) to map any input to a probability between 0 and 1. A threshold (usually 0.5) converts the probability to a class label. Ideal baseline for binary classification — interpretable, fast, well-calibrated.</div>
    </div>

    <div class="explain-card ec-cyan">
      <div class="ec-h4" style="color:var(--a2);">📏 Why Accuracy Alone Fails</div>
      <div class="ec-p">With 88% Low Risk customers, a model that <em>always</em> predicts Low Risk achieves <strong style="color:#fff;">88% accuracy</strong> but catches <strong style="color:var(--red);">zero fraudsters</strong>. We need Precision, Recall, F1, and AUC-ROC to measure what actually matters.</div>
    </div>

    <div class="explain-card ec-red">
      <div class="ec-h4" style="color:var(--red);">🚨 Type-I vs Type-II Errors</div>
      <div class="ec-p">
        <strong style="color:#fff;">Type-I (False Positive):</strong> Good customer flagged as risky → inconvenience, lost revenue.<br/>
        <strong style="color:var(--red);">Type-II (False Negative):</strong> High-risk customer missed → 🚨 FRAUD LOSSES. In banking, <em>minimizing Type-II is paramount</em>.
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="explain-card ec-green">
      <div class="ec-h4" style="color:var(--a4);">📊 Precision, Recall & F1</div>
      <div class="ec-p">
        <strong style="color:#fff;">Precision</strong> = TP/(TP+FP) — Of predicted positives, how many correct?<br/>
        <strong style="color:#fff;">Recall (TPR)</strong> = TP/(TP+FN) — Of actual positives, how many caught?<br/>
        <strong style="color:#fff;">F1-Score</strong> = 2×P×R/(P+R) — Harmonic mean, balances both.
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="explain-card ec-yellow">
      <div class="ec-h4" style="color:var(--yellow);">📈 AUC-ROC Explained</div>
      <div class="ec-p">The ROC curve plots <strong style="color:#fff;">TPR vs FPR</strong> across all decision thresholds. AUC = area under this curve. AUC=1.0 → perfect separator. AUC=0.5 → random guessing. Our best model achieves <strong style="color:var(--a4);">AUC = 0.9998</strong> — near-perfect discrimination.</div>
    </div>

    <div class="explain-card ec-pink">
      <div class="ec-h4" style="color:var(--a3);">⚖️ Why Imbalance Causes Problems</div>
      <div class="ec-p">Models minimize the loss function — dominated by the majority class. With 88:12 split, the model learns to predict "Low Risk" for everything to achieve low loss. Result: <strong style="color:var(--red);">Recall ≈ 0</strong> for the minority class we actually care about. SMOTE and ADASYN fix this by creating synthetic minority samples.</div>
    </div>

  </div>
</div>

<!-- IMBALANCE SECTION -->
<div class="section reveal" id="imbalance">
  <div class="sec-eyebrow">⚖️ Handling</div>
  <div class="sec-title">Imbalanced Data Techniques</div>
  <div class="explain-grid">
    <div class="explain-card ec-red">
      <div class="ec-h4" style="color:var(--red);">🔻 Under-Sampling</div>
      <div class="ec-p">Removes majority class samples randomly until classes are balanced. <strong style="color:#fff;">Pro:</strong> Fast, no synthetic data. <strong style="color:var(--red);">Con:</strong> Data loss — 3,234 Low Risk records thrown away. Risk: losing important patterns. Best when majority class has truly redundant records.</div>
    </div>
    <div class="explain-card ec-cyan">
      <div class="ec-h4" style="color:var(--a2);">🔺 Over-Sampling (ROS)</div>
      <div class="ec-p">Duplicates existing minority class records. <strong style="color:#fff;">Pro:</strong> No data loss. <strong style="color:var(--yellow);">Con:</strong> Exact duplicates — overfitting risk. The model sees the same 446 high-risk records repeated many times, learning them by rote rather than their patterns.</div>
    </div>
    <div class="explain-card ec-purple">
      <div class="ec-h4" style="color:var(--accent);">✨ SMOTE — Our Choice</div>
      <div class="ec-p"><strong>S</strong>ynthetic <strong>M</strong>inority <strong>O</strong>versampling <strong>TE</strong>chnique. Creates <em>new</em> synthetic records by interpolating between existing minority samples in feature space. <strong style="color:#fff;">Pro:</strong> No exact duplicates, richer distribution. This is why SMOTE is the industry standard for imbalanced classification.</div>
    </div>
    <div class="explain-card ec-green">
      <div class="ec-h4" style="color:var(--a4);">🧠 ADASYN — Adaptive SMOTE</div>
      <div class="ec-p">Adaptive Synthetic Sampling — generates <em>more</em> synthetic samples near decision boundaries where the classifier struggles. Focuses effort where discrimination is hardest. <strong style="color:#fff;">Pro:</strong> Smarter sampling. <strong style="color:var(--yellow);">Con:</strong> Slightly lower precision than SMOTE in this dataset.</div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<button class="btt" onclick="window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'})" title="Back to Top">↑</button>

<script>
/* ── PARTICLE NETWORK ─────────────────────────────────────── */
const cv=document.getElementById('bg-canvas'),ctx=cv.getContext('2d');
let W,H,pts=[];
function resize(){W=cv.width=window.innerWidth;H=cv.height=window.innerHeight;}
resize();window.addEventListener('resize',resize);
const colors=['rgba(124,58,237,','rgba(6,182,212,','rgba(236,72,153,','rgba(16,185,129,'];
for(let i=0;i<100;i++) pts.push({
  x:Math.random()*9999,y:Math.random()*9999,
  vx:(Math.random()-.5)*.35,vy:(Math.random()-.5)*.35,
  r:Math.random()*2.2+.5,
  c:colors[Math.floor(Math.random()*colors.length)]+(Math.random()*.5+.2)+')'
});
(function draw(){
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
  pts.forEach(p=>{
    p.x=(p.x+p.vx+W)%W;p.y=(p.y+p.vy+H)%H;
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,p.r,0,Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fillStyle=p.c;ctx.fill();
  });
  for(let i=0;i<pts.length;i++) for(let j=i+1;j<pts.length;j++){
    const d=Math.hypot(pts[i].x-pts[j].x,pts[i].y-pts[j].y);
    if(d<130){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(pts[i].x,pts[i].y);ctx.lineTo(pts[j].x,pts[j].y);
      ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(124,58,237,${(1-d/130)*.1})`;ctx.lineWidth=.6;ctx.stroke();}
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(draw);
})();

/* ── SCROLL REVEAL ────────────────────────────────────────── */
const io=new IntersectionObserver(es=>es.forEach(e=>{
  if(e.isIntersecting) e.target.classList.add('visible');
}),{threshold:.08});
document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(el=>io.observe(el));

/* ── ANIMATED BARS (fire on scroll) ─────────────────────── */
let perfFired=false,rocFired=false;
const perfObs=new IntersectionObserver(es=>es.forEach(e=>{
  if(e.isIntersecting && !perfFired){
    perfFired=true;
    document.querySelectorAll('#perfBars .perf-fill').forEach((el,i)=>{
      setTimeout(()=>{el.style.width=el.dataset.w+'%';},i*120);
    });
  }
}),{threshold:.2});
const perfEl=document.getElementById('perf');
if(perfEl) perfObs.observe(perfEl);

const rocObs=new IntersectionObserver(es=>es.forEach(e=>{
  if(e.isIntersecting && !rocFired){
    rocFired=true;
    document.querySelectorAll('#rocBars .roc-fill').forEach((el,i)=>{
      setTimeout(()=>{el.style.width=el.dataset.w+'%';},i*150);
    });
  }
}),{threshold:.2});
const rocEl=document.getElementById('roc');
if(rocEl) rocObs.observe(rocEl);
</script>
